name: Jada
overview: Jada is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified as the son of Onam and grandson of Jerahmeel according to 1 Chronicles 2:28. His lineage places him within the genealogical records of Judah, highlighting his familial heritage within the Israelite community. No additional notes are provided about his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Jada means 'shrewd one' or '[God] has cared,' reflecting attributes of discernment or divine providence. This proper name is not indicated as given directly by God and is recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:28.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jada as the son of Onam. Additionally, it is inferred from related genealogical passages that Jada may be connected to Jether and Jonathan as ancestors, though these relationships are not explicitly stated for Jada himself but are linked through his broader family line in 1 Chronicles 2:32.
scriptureSignificance: Jada's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical framework of the tribe of Judah. His mention as a descendant of Jerahmeel situates him within the historical lineage that traces the descendants of Judah, an important tribe in biblical history. While the Scriptures do not elaborate on his personal deeds, his record contributes to the preservation of the family lines that are foundational to the biblical narrative of Israel's heritage.
